name: Taurine
summary: Taurine is a conditionally essential amino acid reframed since 2023 as a longevity candidate after animal research linked taurine deficiency to aging. A 2024 meta-analysis of 9 RCTs in overweight/obesity found metabolic benefits (triglycerides, total cholesterol, fasting insulin down); a 2025 RCT showed improved blood pressure and vascular function in type 2 diabetes. A 2025 counter-finding that taurine may not reliably decline with age in primates/humans complicates the founding premise.
description: Canonical taurine research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until the aging-biomarker RCT readouts, the age-decline counter-evidence is adjudicated, and dose standardization have passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: osmoregulation; bile acid conjugation; vascular endothelial function; metabolic regulation
